FONTLOG for Inkterface Mono
===========================

Inkterface Mono is a Modified Version of IBM Plex Mono 2.3 (Regular and Bold), made for the Inkterface e-paper display. It is
distributed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 (OFL.txt in this folder). The Reserved Font Name "Plex" is not used for the
name of this font.

Original work
-------------
IBM Plex Mono, Copyright 2017 IBM Corp. (with Reserved Font Name "Plex"), designed by Mike Abbink, Paul van der Laan and Pieter van
Rosmalen of Bold Monday. https://github.com/IBM/plex . The unmodified originals are kept in decky/fonts-src/ together with the
licence.

Changes in Inkterface Mono
--------------------------
1. All TrueType hinting instructions were removed: the font program (fpgm), control value program (prep), control values (cvt),
   gasp, hdmx, LTSH and VDMX tables, and the instructions of every glyph. Outlines, metrics, kerning and OpenType layout tables are
   unchanged.
   Why: FreeType uses a font's own instructions when it has them. Plex's instructions round the stem of each glyph on its own, so at
   small sizes on a 1-bit display some letters (l, f, T) get 2 px stems and others (i, t, h) 1 px. Without instructions FreeType uses
   its auto-hinter, which gives every stem of a size the same width.
2. The font is renamed "Inkterface Mono" (name records 1, 3, 4, 6; name 5 and 10 describe the change). Copyright, licence, designer,
   manufacturer and trademark records are kept.

How it is made
--------------
decky/scripts/make_inkterface_mono.py (fonttools, pinned in decky/fonts-src/requirements.txt) derives both files from the originals
and can verify the committed files with --check.

Licence
-------
SIL Open Font License 1.1. The fonts are not sold on their own.
